name: Airbus EC155 / H155
summary: A stretched, upgraded Dauphin with a five-blade rotor, ducted tail fan and retractable gear; used offshore and for VIP transport.

engines: Exhausts at the rear of the cowling
fuselage: Long glazed cabin, stretched compared to a Dauphin, with an extra side window
tail: Fenestron (ducted fan) tail with a vertical fin

tellTales: Ducted tail fan on a big twin with retractable wheels
Long cabin with large oval windows

confusedWith.howToTell: The Dauphin is shorter with a four-blade rotor; the EC155 has five blades and a longer cabin.
The H160 has curved Blue Edge blade tips and a sleeker butterfly tail; the EC155 is boxier.
The AW139 has a conventional tail rotor and bigger sponsons; the EC155 has a ducted fan.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
